why: The shopper asked which generator to buy, and ChatGPT answered with five carded generators and picked one; the only add-on it mentions is a transfer switch or interlock that a licensed electrician installs, which is an installation job rather than a set the shopper adds to a cart. What decides the pick is whether the generator has true 120/240V split-phase output and enough running watts, since the 50A receptacle does not mean 50A at 240V, and that comparison belongs on a single-product page.
